corrections.hardware: NVIDIA A100 GPU; GMP baseline on AMD EPYC 7352 CPU (sequential)
corrections.caveats: Fork of coancea/midint-arithmetic; no LICENSE file in fork or visible in parent, so reference-only; whole A100 GPU (batched) vs sequential single-core CPU GMP; README says it does not outperform CGBN (CGBN lacks division above 2^15 bits); CUDA, not a plain C++ library; arXiv preprint, no venue stated.

notes: Numbers match the paper exactly. Shortcomings to record: no license (reference), GPU-batched vs sequential CPU GMP is apples-to-oranges, slower than CGBN where CGBN applies, stale (last commit 2025-06-26).

tier_reason: arXiv preprint (Das, Bichhawat, Patel) compares DoT-integrated GMP 6.3.0 and OpenSSL 3.5.2 against stock versions with clang 14 -O2 -march=native on named Xeons, but the code is only at an anonymous review URL that could not be opened (robots-disallowed) and no venue is stated, so neither A nor B.

corrections.claimed_speedup: DoTMP vs GMP geomean: addition 3.81x, subtraction 3.73x, multiplication 1.41x (512-32768-bit operands); DoTSSL vs OpenSSL: addition 2.95x, subtraction 4.08x; pi computation up to 19.3% faster; larger-operand multiplication up to 48.7% (Emerald Rapids, AVX-512)
corrections.caveats: Code only at anonymous.4open.science/r/DigitsOnTurbo (blocked to fetchers, not verified); no license found; preprint with no venue stated; headline geomeans are on AVX-512 Emerald Rapids.

notes: Numbers verified in Section 4.4 of the arXiv HTML. Record the shortcomings: no public repo or license, and the code was not verifiable.

tier_reason: First-party flintlib.org applications page gives GMP vs FLINT timings (pi 62.1 s vs 31.6 s / 9.34 s 8-thread; 100x100 matmul table) on a Ryzen 7 PRO 5850U, but there is no compiler/flags and no linked benchmark code.

corrections.claimed_speedup: pi (100M digits): GMP 62.1 s vs FLINT 31.6 s single-thread (~2.0x, derived from page data), 9.34 s on 8 threads (~6.6x, derived from page data); 100x100 matmul vs GMP naive (0.0122/0.0172/0.159 s at 10/100/1000 bits): FLINT optimized 0.0000678/0.00235/0.0456 s single-thread, 0.0000675/0.000800/0.0142 s 8-thread; FLINT naive 0.00395/0.0213/0.163 s

notes: Numbers match. The license is LGPL v3+ (the repo ships COPYING for the GPL text that the LGPL references); revert if the orchestrator has evidence of a GPL-or option. Shortcomings: first-party, no flags; naive matmul slower than GMP at 100/1000 bits; issue 2852 not opened.
